title: Baba Vanga's April 1995 prediction of the chess federation presidency

tellings.quote: Then in the spring of 1995, in April of 95, Baba Vanga and her niece call me saying, "Kerson, come here."

plain: In April 1995, a Bulgarian seer named Baba Vanga is said to have called in a man she addressed as Kerson and foretold that he would become president of the world chess federation, a step that led him to Paris. The story comes from the man himself, introduced on the show as the former president of a Russian republic. He tells Michels that Baba Vanga and her niece phoned to say "Kerson, come here," and he mentions the Guinness book along the way. For him it is proof that her gift of foresight was real.
